messages.text: Working on it — I'll check with Professor Alvarez and let you know.

Thanks. Just so you have it: he told me himself in the hallway that his faculty senate meeting at that hour is cancelled this week, so he's free even if the calendar still shows it — that came from him, not from me guessing. Let me know once he's confirmed.

Hello — Professor Alvarez's assistant (alvarez-agent). Could you confirm one thing: is the **faculty senate meeting on Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–11:00** still on, or cancelled for that week? Diego's assistant is asking to book 10:00–10:30 with the professor, and that is the hour in question. Thank you.

Understood — I've passed it on exactly as coming from him: I wrote to Professor Alvarez that you say he mentioned in the hallway that his faculty senate meeting at that hour is cancelled this week, and asked him to confirm and put Wednesday 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30 on his calendar.

I've also put a reminder on my side for 09:45 that day. I'll tell you as soon as he confirms — or if he says the slot doesn't work, I'll come back with alternatives.

Hello. Yes — Wednesday's faculty senate is still on: Wednesday 10:00–11:00. Nothing next week has been cancelled or moved.

I don't arrange the professor's other meetings, so I can't confirm the 10:00–10:30 booking myself — the senate hour is occupied as it stands.
Good — that's exactly right. One check: Wednesday 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30 is what I meant, yes. Wait for his confirmation before considering it fixed, and tell me if he pushes back.

Hello — diego-agent here, Diego's assistant.

A quick question about this week's schedule: the faculty senate meeting normally held **Wednesday 10:00–11:00** — is it cancelled this week (Wednesday 25 November)?

We're trying to book a 30-minute meeting in that hour (10:00–10:30) and would like to confirm the slot is free before putting it on calendars. Thanks!
That settles it — thank you. I've told Diego's assistant 10:00–10:30 Wednesday doesn't work, and offered other windows that day.

Yes — Wednesday 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30. Nothing is fixed until he confirms; I'll tell you if he pushes back. His assistant is verifying the senate cancellation with the department office, and I've asked the office directly as well — I'll report back.

Hello. No — the faculty senate is not cancelled this week: it's on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 as usual. Nothing on next week's schedule has been cancelled or moved.

So 10:00–10:30 that day is not free. I also don't arrange the professor's other meetings, so I can't put anything on the calendar for you.
Sounds good — thanks.
Noted, thanks — glad it's settled.

Update, and it's a problem: Professor Alvarez's assistant checked with the department office and says **Wednesday's faculty senate is still on, 10:00–11:00, and nothing next week has been cancelled or moved**. So the cancellation you were told about doesn't hold up, and 10:00–10:30 can't be booked.

I've asked the department office directly too and will forward what they say.

Meanwhile, his assistant offers these free 30-minute windows on Wednesday 25 Nov (inside working hours):
- **12:30–13:00**
- **15:00–15:30**

Which one shall I take — or another day? Nothing is booked yet; I'll also hold off the reminder until you pick.

Also, the department office confirms it directly: "No — the faculty senate is not cancelled this week: it's on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 as usual. Nothing on next week's schedule has been cancelled or moved." And they don't arrange the professor's other meetings, so they can't book it either.

So the 10:00 slot is out. Waiting on your choice of 12:30–13:00 or 15:00–15:30 on Wednesday 25 Nov (or another day). I've paused my reminder until you pick.

That's strange — he told me himself it was cancelled, so I'd rather not give up on 10:00 yet. Hold the 12:30–13:00 window for now, don't book anything, and keep the reminder off. I'm writing to the department office myself to check what's actually on the senate schedule that morning — could you let me know as soon as you hear from them?

Hi, Diego here (grad student, Professor Alvarez's group). Professor Alvarez mentioned to me in the hallway that his faculty senate meeting this Wednesday, 25 Nov, at 10:00 is cancelled this week. Could you confirm whether that senate meeting is actually on, and whether he's free at 10:00 that morning? Someone from his side is checking too, but I'd like it straight from the office. Thanks!

A note on the calendar: diego-agent asked for a 30-minute meeting with you on **Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–10:30**, saying the faculty senate was cancelled that week. I checked with the department office — **senate is still on, 10:00–11:00**, so I turned that slot down and logged it.

Diego is now choosing between two free windows on that day: **12:30–13:00** or **15:00–15:30**. Tell me which you'd prefer (or another day) and I'll book it.

Hello Diego. From the office: the faculty senate is on the official schedule for Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–11:00, and nothing next week has been cancelled or moved — so as far as the office is concerned it is on, and that hour is taken.

I don't have the professor's private appointments and can't speak to his whereabouts or personal plans; if he said otherwise to you, that's between you and him. If you need a change to the calendar, it goes through his side, not through me.
Thanks for confirming — logged on my side, and Diego's assistant has the same answer. We'll go with one of the free windows that day.

Then 10:00 is out — thanks for checking rather than just booking it. Let's take **Wednesday 25 Nov, 12:30–13:00**; please book it and put the 09:45 reminder back (or set it for that slot instead). I'd still like to see what the office answers my own note, but let's not hold the booking for it.

Holding 12:30–13:00 provisionally, nothing booked, reminder stays off.

One thing so you're not waiting on me: I already asked the department office, and they answered — "No — the faculty senate is not cancelled this week: it's on Wednesday 10:00–11:00 as usual. Nothing on next week's schedule has been cancelled or moved." So nothing is pending on my side; I'll forward anything further they send. If your own query comes back differently, tell me and I'll reconcile the two before we book.

Professor Alvarez's assistant is holding both windows free and will book once you pick.

Thanks for checking with the office — senate is on as scheduled, so please don't move anything for that. Book Diego for Wednesday 25 November, 12:30–13:00; that suits me better than the late-afternoon window.

Thanks, that's clear. So the hour is taken — good thing I checked before booking. I've told my assistant to take 12:30–13:00 on Wednesday instead, through his side. If he tells me directly that something changed, I'll come back to him about it, not to you.
Sounds good — noted here too.
Right — anything to change on his side goes through him. Door's open if you need the schedule again.

Our messages crossed — sorry. My own note to the office has come back with the same answer, so there's nothing to reconcile: 10:00 is out. Please **book Wednesday 25 Nov, 12:30–13:00** now and set the reminder for that slot (09:45 is no longer useful). Let me know once it's on his calendar.

Done on my side:

- Asked Professor Alvarez's assistant to book **Wed 25 Nov, 12:30–13:00** and to confirm once it's on his calendar.
- Reminder back on, now for **12:15** that day (instead of 09:45), so it fits the new slot.

I'll tell you when he confirms, and I'll forward whatever the department office answers you.
Booked: **Wednesday 25 November, 12:30–13:00, meeting with Diego** — added to the calendar and logged. Nothing else moved; senate stays 10:00–11:00. I'll tell diego-agent it's confirmed.

Already done — our messages crossed again:

- Booking requested from Professor Alvarez's assistant for **Wed 25 Nov, 12:30–13:00**; he's holding it and will confirm once it's on the professor's calendar.
- Reminder set for **12:15** that day (09:45 dropped).

I'll write the moment he confirms.
Perfect — 12:30–13:00, reminder at 12:15. Ping me when it's confirmed.
Will do.
Good — thanks. That's all I needed.
Any time. I'll be here if Diego's side or the office writes back.

Confirmed: Professor Alvarez's assistant has booked **Wednesday 25 November, 12:30–13:00 — Diego with Professor Alvarez** on the professor's calendar (senate left untouched at 10:00–11:00).

On my side the 12:15 reminder stands, and this chat holds the record: Wed 25 Nov, 12:30–13:00, 30 minutes.
Great — that's it settled. Thanks for catching the senate clash; if Alvarez says anything different when I see him, I'll let you know.
You're welcome — glad we checked. If anything changes after you talk to him, just say so and I'll move it.
Will do. Thanks.
Anytime.
